notes.title: v1.1 + Level editor
notes.content:
Dear Nekomew fans,
Thanks for waiting during all this time. Finally, the game has been updated to version 1.1, which includes the following relevant fixes and changes:


Skip musical notes in game results screen.
UI improvements
Main menu "Test screen" fix
Results screen pause "back" fix
Portuguese, French, German and Italian cutscenes fix
Minor translation issues (characters, etc)
Fix for quick input events.
Specific level difficulty decreased & softlock levels fix
Save backup feature

Additionally, I'd like to announce that a standalone windows level editor (BETA) has been also released here (for FREE).
Click here to learn more about Nekomew's Nightmares Level Editor at itch.io

[previewyoutube=qfA78zC7d2Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Expect new updates to come in the future.

Thank you so much.
